name: Piper PA-32 Cherokee Six / Saratoga
variants: Lance / Lance II (PA-32R; Lance II has a T-tail)
summary: Stretched six-seat development of the PA-28 family with fixed or retractable gear, used for personal travel and air taxi.

wings: Low wing; constant-chord on Cherokee Six, tapered on Saratoga
engines: Single flat-six with a long nose
fuselage: Long six-seat cabin with four side windows
Large double rear door on the left plus a front door on the right
Fixed gear (Cherokee Six/6X) or retractable gear (Lance/Saratoga SP)
tail: Swept fin with stabilator; some Lance and Turbo Saratoga models have a T-tail

tellTales: Stretched low-wing single with four side windows per side
Large double rear door on the left side
Long nose well ahead of the windshield

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-28 is shorter with three side windows and only a right door; the PA-32 has an extra window and a double rear door on the left.
The A36 has its rear double doors on the right and a sleeker, rounder fuselage; the PA-32's rear doors are on the left.
The Malibu/M-series has a pressurized cabin with small windows and an airstair door; the PA-32 has large unpressurized windows.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
